name: Dusty Village
desc1: Although well-shielded from the sun's glaring eye and the withering
desc2: winds of the desert, this small village is nonetheless plagued by
desc3: clouds of dust which catch in your throat. The buildings here seem to
desc4: be semi-permanent, constructed of heavy cloth and sturdy poles. The
desc5: only truly permanent structure, a two-stort building made of stone,
desc6: stands to the south, its wooden door sticking out like a sore thumb.
